pages.title: Category Theory
pages.text: $(thing)Category Theory$()$(br2)Objects and arrows. Functors between categories, and toposes - universes with their own logic.

$(thing)Insight$(): 120$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Set Theory, Geometric Topology, Abstract Algebra, Lie Groups.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 16 Function Graph.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): In the category of finite sets, an arrow into C from a product A × B (or a disjoint union with D) is the same as choosing an element of C independently for every point of the source. Count the arrows from (A × B) + D into C as nested products over the points, using cardinalities |X|.
